chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī, from ʿUmar ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “The qunūt on Friday?” He said: “You are my messenger to them regarding this: when you pray in congregation, then it is in the first rakʿah; and when you pray individually, then it is in the second rakʿah.”

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, in the context of Friday prayer

ai.seo_question: In which rakʿah is the qunūt performed in Friday prayer when praying in congregation or alone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the place of qunūt in Friday prayer. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that when the prayer is performed in congregation, the qunūt is in the first rakʿah, and when performed individually, it is in the second rakʿah.
